summary: Acquittal under Section 304B IPC upheld; perversity standard for appellate reversal not met; scratches on body insufficient to prove cruelty without medical opinion; dowry demand unproven due to omissions in Section 161 CrPC statements; hostile witness testimony undermined prosecution case; no corroborative evidence of harassment; presumption under Section 113B Evidence Act not triggered.
legal_provisions_cited: Constable Surender Singh v. State of Uttarakhand
Darshan Singh v. State of Punjab
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction and sentence set aside; acquittal by High Court restored.
